intro.text: A sealed ruin has begun opening every locked thing in the nearby village: cupboards, coffins, promises. At its heart is a door that forgot whether it protects the living from the dead or the dead from the living.

outro.text: The remembering door swings open without anger. Beyond it is not treasure but clean dawn. The village locks stop rattling, and for one night every grave stays politely shut.

storyTriggers.title: A Gate Without Hinges
storyTriggers.text: The gatehouse arch has no door, only hinge scars and a brass keyhole set into empty air.

storyTriggers.title: Unused Keys
storyTriggers.text: Hundreds of keys hang here. None fit anything. All of them are labeled with people names.

storyTriggers.title: Elowen
storyTriggers.text: A brittle ledger says the warden loved a door so much she named it Elowen and stood behind it when raiders came.

storyTriggers.title: The Door Wakes
storyTriggers.text: A wraith peels itself from the final door. It does not attack immediately. It listens for its name.

storyTriggers.title: Memory Unlatched
storyTriggers.text: The wraith breaks into key-shaped sparks. The door remains, but now it remembers how to open.

designNotes.specialLocks: Final door requires Elowen, discoverable in the scribe niche.
